title: Morning Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Morning Sunwatch — November 06, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C2.9 (Peaked November 06, 2026 at 13:47 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: M3.5 (Peaked November 05, 2026 at 18:33 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 350 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.33)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Little flare from the Sun! 💥🌞

Several bright active regions and a visible sunspot group stand out today, with no clear CME seen in the coronagraph image.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 193 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
